// diagnostic

E1296

`{flag}` is not a Jet workspace selector.

What

`{flag}` is not a Jet workspace selector.

Why

D-JPK-SELECTOR1=C rejects pnpm-style `--filter` pattern DSLs; Jet scopes workspace commands with exact `-p <member>` and computed `--affected` / `--affected-since <ref>` only.

Fix

use `-p <member>` (repeatable) or `--affected` / `--affected-since <ref>`.
